title: Smart Data Models - OCDS - Award
description: An award for the given procurement. There can be more than one award per contracting process e.g. because the contract is split among different providers, or because it is a standing offer. (Open Contracting Data Standard 1.1.5, Award: https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Award. Field names are kept verbatim except 'id' -> 'ocdsId' and 'value' -> 'ocdsValue'.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity (NGSI-LD). Built from the OCDS identifiers, see the model notes.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Award'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

ocid.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/properties/ocid'. Open Contracting ID. A globally unique identifier for this Open Contracting Process. Composed of an ocid prefix and an identifier for the contracting process. For more information see the [Open Contracting Identifier guidance](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/identifiers/) Not a field of this OCDS object: added so that the entity can be found by contracting process (in OCDS the object is nested in a release that carries the ocid).

ocdsId.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Award/properties/id'. Award ID. The identifier for this award. It must be unique and must not change within the Open Contracting Process it is part of (defined by a single ocid). See the [identifier guidance](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/identifiers/) for further details. OCDS field 'id', renamed because 'id' is reserved in NGSI-LD.

status.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Award/properties/status'. Award status. The current status of the award, from the closed [awardStatus](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#award-status) codelist. (OCDS closed codelist awardStatus.csv.)

date.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Award/properties/date'. Award date. The date of the contract award. This is usually the date on which a decision to award was made.

ocdsValue.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Award/properties/value'. Value. The total value of this award. In the case of a framework contract this may be the total estimated lifetime value, or maximum value, of the agreement. There may be more than one award per procurement. A negative value indicates that the award may involve payments from the supplier to the buyer (commonly used in concession contracts). OCDS field 'value', renamed because 'value' is reserved in NGSI-LD.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of the amount, from the closed [currency](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#currency) codelist. (OCDS closed codelist currency.csv.)

suppliers.description: Relationship. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Award/properties/suppliers'. Suppliers. The suppliers awarded this award. If different suppliers have been awarded different items or values, these should be split into separate award blocks. In OCDS this is an embedded OrganizationReference; here it points to the Organization entities.

items.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Award/properties/items'. Items awarded. The goods and services awarded in this award, broken into line items wherever possible. Items should not be duplicated, but the quantity specified instead.

items.title: Item
items.description: A good, service, or work to be contracted.

id.title: ID
id.description: A local identifier to reference and merge the items by. Must be unique within a given array of items.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the goods, services to be provided.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: The primary classification for the item.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The scheme or codelist from which the classification code is taken. For line item classifications, this uses the open [itemClassificationScheme](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#item-classification-scheme) codelist. (OCDS open codelist itemClassificationScheme.csv.)

id.title: ID
id.description: The classification code taken from the scheme.

description.title: Description
description.description: A textual description or title for the classification code.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: A URI to uniquely identify the classification code.

additionalClassifications.title: Additional classifications
additionalClassifications.description: An array of additional classifications for the item.

items.title: Classification
items.description: A classification consists of at least two parts: an identifier for the list (scheme) from which the classification is taken, and an identifier for the category from that list being applied. It is useful to also publish a text label and/or URI that users can draw on to interpret the classification.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The scheme or codelist from which the classification code is taken. For line item classifications, this uses the open [itemClassificationScheme](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#item-classification-scheme) codelist. (OCDS open codelist itemClassificationScheme.csv.)

id.title: ID
id.description: The classification code taken from the scheme.

description.title: Description
description.description: A textual description or title for the classification code.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: A URI to uniquely identify the classification code.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: The number of units to be provided.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: A description of the unit in which the supplies, services or works are provided (e.g. hours, kilograms) and the unit-price.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The list from which identifiers for units of measure are taken, using the open [unitClassificationScheme](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#unit-classification-scheme) codelist. 'UNCEFACT' is recommended. (OCDS open codelist unitClassificationScheme.csv.)

id.title: ID
id.description: The identifier from the codelist referenced in the `scheme` field. Check the [unitClassificationScheme](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#unit-classification-scheme) codelist for details of how to find and use identifiers from the scheme in use.

value.title: Value
value.description: The monetary value of a single unit.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of the amount, from the closed [currency](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#currency) codelist. (OCDS closed codelist currency.csv.)

uri.title: URI
uri.description: The machine-readable URI for the unit of measure, provided by the scheme.

contractPeriod.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Award/properties/contractPeriod'. Contract period. The period for which the contract has been awarded.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: The start date for the period. When known, a precise start date must be provided.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: The end date for the period. When known, a precise end date must be provided.

maxExtentDate.description: The period cannot be extended beyond this date. This field can be used to express the maximum available date for extension or renewal of this period.
maxExtentDate.title: Maximum extent

durationInDays.description: The maximum duration of this period in days. A user interface can collect or display this data in months or years as appropriate, and then convert it into days when storing this field. This field can be used when exact dates are not known. If a startDate and endDate are set, this field, if used, should be equal to the difference between startDate and endDate. Otherwise, if a startDate and maxExtentDate are set, this field, if used, should be equal to the difference between startDate and maxExtentDate.
durationInDays.title: Duration (days)

documents.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Award/properties/documents'. Documents. All documents and attachments related to the award, including any notices.

items.title: Document
items.description: Links to, or descriptions of, external documents can be attached at various locations within the standard. Documents can be supporting information, formal notices, downloadable forms, or any other kind of resource that ought to be made public as part of full open contracting.

id.title: ID
id.description: A local, unique identifier for this document. This field is used to keep track of multiple revisions of a document through the compilation from release to record mechanism.

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: A classification of the document described, using the open [documentType](https://standard.open-contracting.org/1.1/en/schema/codelists/#document-type) codelist. (OCDS open codelist documentType.csv.)

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of the document. Descriptions are recommended to not exceed 250 words. In the event the document is not accessible online, the description field can be used to describe arrangements for obtaining a copy of the document.

url.title: URL
url.description: A direct link to the document or attachment. The server providing access to this document ought to be configured to correctly report the document mime type.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: The date on which the document was first published. This is particularly important for legally important documents such as notices of a tender.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Date that the document was last modified

format.title: Format
format.description: The format of the document, using the open [IANA Media Types](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/) codelist (see the values in the 'Template' column), or using the 'offline/print' code if the described document is published offline. For example, web pages have a format of 'text/html'.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the linked document using either two-letter [ISO639-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes), or extended [BCP47 language tags](http://www.w3.org/International/articles/language-tags/). The use of lowercase two-letter codes from [ISO639-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes) is recommended unless there is a clear user need for distinguishing the language subtype.

amendments.description: Property. Model:'https://standard.open-contracting.org/schema/1__1__5/release-schema.json#/definitions/Award/properties/amendments'. Amendments. An award amendment is a formal change to the details of the award, and generally involves the publication of a new award notice/release. The rationale and a description of the changes made can be provided here.

id.description: An identifier for this amendment: often the amendment number
id.title: ID

description.description: A free text, or semi-structured, description of the changes made in this amendment.
description.title: Description

amendsReleaseID.description: Provide the identifier (release.id) of the OCDS release (from this contracting process) that provides the values for this contracting process **before** the amendment was made.
amendsReleaseID.title: Amended release (identifier)

releaseID.description: Provide the identifier (release.id) of the OCDS release (from this contracting process) that provides the values for this contracting process **after** the amendment was made.
releaseID.title: Amending release (identifier)
